title: Reverse removes the invoice and puts the work order back to Complete
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on the Net 30 credit term.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced today (no payment, deposit or credit applied), billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Reverse the invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A, with status Invoiced.

Step 2:

  • The Finance tab lists the invoice, billed to customer B.

Step 3:

  • The invoice is removed.
  • Work order 1's status is Complete.
  • Create Invoice shows again.
